div.head: EGu Prol., 1
div.ab: Ðæt is ærest, þæt hi gecwædon, þæt hí ænne God lufian woldan ⁊ ælcne hæðendom georne aworpen.
Ðis [is] ærest, þæt hig gecwædon, þæt hí ænne God lufian woldon ⁊ ælcne hæþendom georne aworpen.
Inprimis est, quod dixerunt, ut unum Deum diligere uelint et omni paganismo renunciare sedulo.
Ðæt is ærest, þæt hig gecwædon, þæt hí ænne God lufian woldon ⁊ ælcne hæþendom georne aworpen.
Pr.1 Ðæt is ærest þæt hig gecwædon: þæt hi ænne God lufian woldon and ælcne hæþendom georne aweorpen.
In the first place, they declared they would love one God, and zealously renounce all heathen practices.
Pr.1 This is foremost among those things which they agreed upon: that they would love the one God and wholeheartedly reject every heathen practice.
Das ist [nämlich] erstens, dass sie bestimmten, dass sie Einen Gott lieben wollten und jedes Heidenthum eifrig abwerfen.
That is [namely] first, that they determined that they would love one God and zealously cast off all heathenism.
div.note: V Atr 1; V Atr 34; II Cn 5
